changes.evidence: Sinister Strange is a variant from another universe destroyed by an Incursion he caused (Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness), not the main MCU; Marvel Database designates his reality Earth-TRN954 (dataset already gives other variants their own Earths, e.g. Defender Strange Earth-TRN953, the 838 Illuminati Earth-838).

In episode 8 (Ribbit and Rip It), Eugene Patilio leads a squad of hired men guarding his Lily Pad hideout and asks them on screen 'Guys, what do we think about the name Leap Squad?'; they fight She-Hulk and Daredevil for him and are arrested.

owner_calls.question: Should Sinister Strange get a Masters of the Mystic Arts stage (from the start)? He is a Strange variant shown as Sorcerer Supreme in his universe's New York Sanctum, but the film does not clearly name the order for him; Defender Strange already has this stage in the dataset.
options: Add [['Masters of the Mystic Arts','(from the start)']]
owner_calls.evidence: MCU Wiki lists affiliation Masters of the Mystic Arts (Variant) and title Sorcerer Supreme / Master of the New York Sanctum; Marvel Database lists only occupation 'Master of the Mystic Arts' with no affiliation.
